📦 **meadow-category-icons `5fec654`** — Replace town building category emoji with eleven original pixel icons

Generate independent transparent originals with built-in image_gen and retain masters in ArtGallery. Add 128px RGBA derivatives, a reproducible icon bundle, Chinese labels, 32px pixel rendering and bounded scrolling on short screens.

Verified: actual menu renderer and real host townBuildMenu payload in isolated Chrome DOM at 1280x900, 390x844 and 640x390; all eleven categories selected by pointer events. Unknown and prototype category keys retain safe text. Missing PNG negative control rejected; restored bundle matches. Build --code, AST/global/layer gates and srccheck pass (6bda0179d1b648da; 183 sources; 37 ship files unchanged). This is UI verification, not a full town simulation run.

Refs TASK-1150

👥 參與者：@meadow
